q1_issues.issue: "finds out" is an eventive mental verb (it accepts the progressive, "is finding out"), so by the progressive test in Thematic roles its transitive subject is an ordinary Agent, not Experiencer.
The discovered error undergoes no change and the event is not a stative psych state, so its object role is Theme, not Stimulus.
Location is attached to an entity (the error), which the instruction set forbids outright — the head is the event-vs-entity distinction, so an entity's position may never take the event oblique.

q2_gaps: Entity-attached PP naming abstract / documentary containment ("an error in the ledger"): the instruction set routes entity-attached PPs only for physical position (LocatedIn), origin (From), and framing domain (In on the claim), and gives no rule choosing among LocatedIn, PartOf, or a preposition-named entity oblique for content held inside a record.
notes: The phrasal verb is handled correctly — find_out kept whole as one surface symbol, no genus, no single-word synonym. The instruction set is in tension on the role point: the propositional-attitudes bullet says a psych/attitude verb with an entity object "keeps Experiencer / Stimulus", while Thematic roles' progressive test explicitly puts eventive discovery verbs on Agent.
